metadata.description: Function-hook mods for Claude Code: a limits telemetry row, multi-select question and next-step panes, and README updates after every commit.

plugins.name: token-ledger
plugins.description: 5-hour, weekly, context and cache-hit figures in one row above the prompt, a ? button for Haiku questions that learns your project and feedback, a /brief pane to see and correct it, and a /ledger pane.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: 1-3 suggested next prompts after each real turn, tick any number and insert them together.

plugins.name: auto-docs
plugins.description: After each commit, updates README.md (or the docs you list) in a follow-up docs commit.
